personality_one_liner: An elegant, minimalist, and editorial mobile experience that frames at-home grooming as a premium bespoke service.

spacing.rule: Generous editorial whitespace. Let typography breathe. Use margins to isolate content blocks instead of heavy cards.

do's: Use solid surfaceSecondary or brand tinted backgrounds instead of glass for this editorial style.
dont's: No heavy blurs, keep it matte and paper-like.

screens.name: Inicio
screens.purpose: Establish the premium brand narrative and build trust.

states.error: Elegant text message 'No se pudo cargar la información' with retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with 'Miguel Suárez' in Italiana. Hero section: Full-width atmospheric grooming image with vertical gradient scrim, Italiana H1 'Precisión y estilo, donde tú estés' and pill-shaped primary CTA. Trust bar: 3 items in a horizontal scroll or spaced row. About: Portrait image with narrative text. Process: Vertical list with large editorial numbering (01., 02.) in Italiana. Reviews: Horizontal scroll of dark ink cards with a large transparent 'M' monogram background. FAQ: Minimalist accordion with thin 1px bottom borders.

screens.name: Servicios
screens.purpose: Showcase offerings with clear pricing and zone information.

states.empty: No services available at the moment.

screens.layout: List of services using generous vertical padding, separated by thin hairline borders. Each service has title, price, duration, and a 'Reservar' pill button. Packages section: Gradient bronze cards for Weddings/Groups. Zones: Simple text list or chips. Gallery: Minimalist grid of ambient photos or 'Fotografía pendiente' empty states.

screens.name: Reservar
screens.layout: Step-by-step flow (Service -> Date/Time -> Details). Use large touch targets for time slots. Form fields with labels above and thin bottom borders (no full boxes). Sticky 'Confirmar Reserva' button at the bottom above safe area.

screens.name: Contacto
screens.layout: Large WhatsApp button using the 'success' color (#1F8F55). List of policies and social links. Minimalist and spacious.

screens.name: Admin (Hidden Route)
screens.layout: Login screen with simple inputs. Dashboard with tabs to edit Services, Zones, FAQ, Reviews.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality. Use generous whitespace, hairline borders, and elegant serif typography.
Implement the sticky header with 'Miguel Suárez' in the Italiana font.
Use 'brandPrimary' (#181815) with 'pill' radius for primary buttons, creating an ink-colored pill CTA.
For the Process section, use large numbers (01., 02.) in the Italiana font to create an editorial numbering aesthetic.
Reviews section MUST use dark ink cards (`surfaceInverse`) with a large, low-opacity 'M' in the background.
Packages section MUST use a bronze gradient or the provided leather texture image for background.
Avoid ALL traditional barbershop icons (clippers, barber poles). Use minimalist icons from Feather, with stroke width 1 or 1.5.
Ensure the layout feels like a premium lifestyle magazine rather than a dense SaaS dashboard.
Ensure 'Reservar' is highly visible, ideally as a sticky CTA at the bottom of the screen or prominently in the header/tab bar.
DO NOT USE EMOJIS in the UI.
